## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run build` and `npx vitest run` pass
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that fails without it
- [ ] User-visible changes are in `CHANGELOG.md`, and in the README or `docs/` if they describe it
- [ ] No credentials, real memory contents or personal paths in the diff
- [ ] The 15 tool names and the documented output fields are unchanged (or this PR says why)
